edits.old: Then an event carries identifiers and business facts only
edits.new:
Then an event carries identifiers and business facts only

  Scenario: AC7 The business rules of the registry hold (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the registry of the event catalogue, its build gate and its access controls
    When the registry is read, a schema is registered and a build runs
    Then every event type has one subject named <topic>-<Event> (BR1)
    Then the compatibility level of every subject is BACKWARD (BR2)
    Then a breaking change is a new major version and a new event type version, and the previous major version stays in force until its event type is retired (BR3)
    Then the ce_type value carries the major version of the event type (BR4)
    Then each AsyncAPI 3.0 document covers one topic and every message of that document references a registered subject (BR5)
    Then the build validates every produced schema and every AsyncAPI document against the registry, and a merge without a green gate is not possible (BR6)
    Then a service writes only its own subjects and reads the catalogue, and every registration is attributed and logged (BR7)
    Then the registry holds schema documents, versions, checksums and references only, with no business value, business data or rule (BR8)
